pages.text: Each group, except sugar, gives you positive effects: increased health, resistance to repulsion, and armor hardness. When all the groups except sugar are pumped, the level of these effects increases.

and the damage and attack speed are additionally increased.$(br2)You may have a question - what's wrong with sugar? It's simple, when pumping it, you move faster, but you also get the effect of Hunger. If you keep pumping sugar, sooner or later you will die.
